set.body: Acceptance criteria: Detector.idt implements the Salvucci-Goldberg minimum-duration sliding-window procedure, advances the candidate start when the initial window fails, expands qualifying windows, states its dispersion convention, and has explicit invalid-sample behavior. Published or hand-computable fixtures cover initial noise, isolated outliers, clustered subthreshold segments, and end boundaries. Extrema maintenance is not quadratic on a long stationary run. The current maximal bounding-box-run algorithm is removed or retained under an honest descriptive name with separate metadata.
set.title: Implement canonical I-DT under the canonical name
